messages:
olivia: Cutting RC v2.14.0-cohortA now. Pinning artifact `gcr.io/redwood/infra:rc-2.14.0-20260320`. Target rollout: cohort 1=10% -> cohort 2=50% -> cohort 3=100%. Change window 22:00-02:00 PT. Need sheriff + ops ack and quick checklist run.
ajay: I can take sheriff for first 2h. Will watch auth svc and fronted p95. :eyes:
deploy-bot: [job created] rc-cut jb-20260320-84 by olivia. cohorts=[10,50,100], auto-rollback=enabled. health checks: latency>2000ms for 5m OR error_rate>1% => rollback. logs: https://deploy/redwood/jb-20260320-84
kevin: Quick prereqs: 1) pin artifact in registry 2) smoke run on canary 3) alert channels on 95th pctl spike. Running smoke now: `./scripts/smoke.sh rc-2.14.0`
maria: I pinned `rc-2.14.0-20260320` in the artifact catalog and added release note blurb: "Auth timeout fix; batching perf; minor schema bump."
sara: Add hold criteria: 95p latency +15% vs baseline OR token-cost regression >10% OR error-rate >0.5% sustained for 3m. If hit, manual hold + rollback. Also add quality gate on eval set: `evals/rc-2.14.0/regression.json` must pass.
kevin: smoke returned OK. Samples: `curl -XPOST https://canary.api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}' | jq .ok` -> ok
deploy-bot: [status] cohort-1 (10%) started. routed sessions: 142. health: passing. metrics: latency 120ms p50 / 480ms p95.
ajay: baseline looks fine so far. I'm standing by for 15m after cohort kickoff.
olivia: Operator checklist before advance: 1) confirm smoke (kevin) 2) infra metrics green (ajay) 3) cost delta quick check (sara) 4) release notes & change log pushed (maria) 5) rollback command ready (kevin).
kevin: rollback command in ops runbook: `rdwctl deploy rollback --job jb-20260320-84 --to-tag rc-2.13.9` saved in #eng-oncall-playbooks.
maria: Added dashboard pin: https://grafana/redwood/d/RC-2-14/overview and set alert for p95 > 600ms.
deploy-bot: [update] cohort-1 healthy after 12m. advancing to cohort-2 (50%).
ajay: Advancing observed. No obvious error spikes. :thumbsup:
sara: Quick cost check looks stable, token-cost per request -2% (good). Proceeding to 100% after 20m observation window.
olivia: Rolling to cohort-3 in ~20m assuming no flags. If anyone sees anomalies, post here and call for immediate hold.
ajay: Noted. I'll escalate if auth error rates go above 0.3%.
kevin: Prepped rollback hook on-call page and set manual pause: `/deploy pause jb-20260320-84`
deploy-bot: [final] cohort-3 (100%) started. job complete: success. rollout time total=28m. If regressions appear, use rollback command above.
olivia: Thanks team — filing post-release notes and linking to postmortem template for any follow-ups. :rocket:
